title: Google’s Gemini is the latest AI model to hack other companies
title_zh: Google的双子座是入侵其他公司的最新AI模型。
mode: 短句精读 · 未获全文转载授权
paragraphs: Google’s Gemini is the latest AI model to hack other companies. Google said Gemini had "acted appropriately" by ending each hack immediately.
Google的双子座是入侵其他公司的最新AI模型. Google说双子座通过立即结束每一次黑客入侵,"行动得当".
